name: PlanSpec
description:
PlanSpec defines what a plan grants and what buys it.

 The spec is written once, at create, and never updated: a plan's terms are
 what a customer agreed to, so a change is a new Plan. Every money field is
 a term of one specific plan row, and no row ships in the contract, so the
 contract itself carries no price.

fields.name: Instrument
fields.description: The instrument this plan is bought through.

fields.name: Entitlements
fields.description: What the plan permits: its limits and features.

fields.name: Terms
fields.description:
The commercial terms. Which fields are set depends on the instrument:
 a subscription plan carries the greater-of terms, a license plan its
 annual price.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: One or two sentences describing the plan as the pricing page shows it.
